verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents APIs for listing and fetching cases "for information retrieval or data syncing", plus case-data exports: one-click case download, a Reports > History export including comments, and CSV downloads from analytics tables. That covers the case portion of the story, but the evidence is silent on customer, alert and decision exports and never mentions stable identifiers for reconciliation, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented export of customer, alert and decision data, explicit stable/persistent identifiers suited to reconciliation, a published API reference or schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
